observed_behavior: Filing an issue immediately created canonical requirements, UAT obligations, and prospective traceability relationships before implementation was authorized or begun.
expected_behavior: Issue-local behavior enters requirements, UAT, and traceability only when standalone implementation is authorized or implementation begins for a plan or campaign containing the issue.
causal_mechanism: Reusable policy treated issue intake, stakeholder approval, plan association, and implementation activation as one requirements-ingestion event.

anti_pattern.structural_description: One lifecycle event both records a proposed issue and activates its behavior as a project requirement.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: Unimplemented, deferred, or rejected proposals immediately make the project appear to lack required implementation and acceptance coverage.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: Issue intake does not change canonical requirements; reconciliation occurs only at one of the two explicit implementation-activation gates.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: Keep absent expected behavior issue-local, permit links to existing approved requirements, and reconcile requirements, UAT, traceability, and active-work state atomically when implementation activates.

applicability_conditions: A project uses issues to record proposed or defective behavior separately from implementation work.
Requirements coverage validation treats canonical requirements as currently approved implementation obligations.
known_non_matches: Linking an issue at intake to an approved requirement that already exists does not create or activate a new requirement.
confirmation_evidence: The former requirements policy said reconciliation was not deferred until an issue entered active work.
The former issue policy prescribed prospective requirement annotations as part of issue intake.
regression_proofs: tests/issue-requirement-activation-policy.test.js: issue intake uses configured type ownership without promoting requirements
tests/issue-requirement-activation-policy.test.js: requirements activate only for standalone authorization or begun planned implementation
tests/plan-execution-policy.test.js: standalone and planned issue execution share the implementation activation gate
